title: MetadataBundle
description: The required semantic/provenance envelope every usable Yggdrasil object must carry. Encodes the orthogonal semantic dimensions (docs/architecture/semantic-dimensions.md) and the provenance/scope/identity required by docs/architecture/metadata-bundle.md. source_role, authority_state, and evidence_role are three separate required fields and must never be collapsed. vault_id is storage topology and is not equivalent to scope_id. A vector/chunk without object_id, object_type, scope_id, source_role, authority_state, evidence_role, and provenance fails validation.

object_id.description: Stable identity of the object this bundle describes.

vault_id.description: Physical/storage root (VaultRoot) the object's bytes live in. Storage topology only; NOT equivalent to scope_id.

workspace_id.description: Active working surface the object was produced under, where applicable. Context, not identity or authority.

scope_id.description: Primary scope binding: cognitive frame + audience boundary + policy boundary + provenance context. Membership only; never a cross-scope grant.

sphere.description: Human-facing life-domain (work, private, RPG). Not a sufficient policy boundary by itself.

principal_id.description: Identified actor (human or delegated agent role) the object is attributed to, where applicable.

scope_binding.description: Full scope membership, including multi-scope membership beyond the primary scope_id. Membership is not permission.

created_by.description: Actor (principal/agent role/system) that created this object.

derived_from.description: Object IDs this object was derived/rebuilt from. Required for derived/rebuildable object types so provenance survives derivation.

content_hash.description: Content digest for integrity and rebuild verification.

provenance_event_ids.description: ProvenanceEvent references that carry origin AND justification. At least one (the creation/capture event) is always present.

valid_at.description: Start of the object's validity window, where applicable.

invalid_at.description: End of the object's validity window (invalidation), where applicable.

indexed_at.description: When a derived/index representation was last (re)built, where applicable.

memory_state.description: Memory lifecycle position; only meaningful when object_type is memory_item (see memory-item.schema.json).

execution_state.description: Side-effect status; only meaningful when object_type is execution_effect.

authority_receipt_ref.description: AuthorityReceipt that recorded the governed transition giving this object its current standing. Required when authority_state is accepted/canonical.

allOf.$comment: Derived/rebuildable representations must carry provenance lineage (derived_from).
Canonical standing requires a governance receipt; no field promotes authority_state without one.

A memory item must carry its memory lifecycle state, and — even when carried only as a bundle (e.g. inside a retrieval candidate or context envelope) — must not claim real-world evidence standing. This mirrors memory-item.schema.json's non-authoritative evidence restriction so machine memory cannot enter retrieval/context as factual evidence.
Execution cannot authorize itself: an execution effect carries a status and the receipt that authorized it.
Projection is not evidence by default: a projection may hold evidence_role only via a provenance-backed promotion receipt.
